results.rationale: The maze, animal and presents retain their designs, but the overall diagram shifts left. A straight red arrow points toward the gifts instead of tracing the maze corridors, crossing several black walls. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. The edited diagram and arrow are clean, legible and structurally coherent.

The spoon bowl, upper stem and wood-grain background are preserved. A full-length rounded handle with a hanging hole completes the spoon, though its join to the old stem has a small visible step. The edited object looks natural apart from that minor seam.
